points.text: The linked article reports that GTA VI builds clear Lucia's prologue and reach Jason's first mission.
The linked article reports that Take-Two's DMCA notice took down 3,007 GitHub repos and ended Leonida.
The tracker records that hyphennn now claims the stage "playable".
The tracker records that GTA6-COMPAT-LAYER (ScarlettCompat) now claims the stage "loads".
The linked article reports that GTA VI's shaders start loading on omonkey's build, streamed live on Rumble.

sentences.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two filed a DMCA notice against Leonida, disabling 3,007 forks.
The linked article says Leonida’s Discord server vanished, with members claiming a ban.
Make Tech Easier reports that the DMCA notice ended Leonida, the unofficial GTA 6 PC recompilation project.
The linked article reports that several private PC builds can now play through Lucia's prologue and into Jason's first mission, "Gone Fishing".
The linked article says that most builds still render badly and vehicles rarely work, with the boat often unsteerable in "Gone Fishing".
The linked article claims that the people achieving this are working in private and likely build on hyphennn's victory-fork, though their changes are not public.

items.headline: Leaked Xbox Build Sparks Port Efforts

sentences.text: SSBCrack reports that a GTA 6 leaker released an Xbox build executable, raising fears of an unofficial PC port.
LevelUp says that CyberLeek leaked the executable file and modders are already working on a playable PC version.
Digg claims that CyberLeek leaked a GTA 6 development build but omitted the file that runs it.
